scenarios.name: home
scenarios.exercises: plain SSR render, no server load

scenarios.name: item-html
scenarios.exercises: dynamic route param, server load, searchParams, escape_html, devalue uneval inlined in HTML

scenarios.name: item-data-json
scenarios.exercises: __data.json path: devalue stringify of Date/Map/Set/BigInt/RegExp/NaN/-0/undefined and a repeated reference

scenarios.name: item-cookie-read
scenarios.exercises: cookie parse on the way in, two Set-Cookie headers on the way out

scenarios.name: item-not-found
scenarios.exercises: error(404) from load, +error.svelte render, $app/state page store

scenarios.name: escape-static
scenarios.exercises: escape_html on a script tag literal, plus {@html} passthrough

scenarios.name: escape-user-input
scenarios.exercises: percent-decoding of query values then escape_html in text and attribute position

scenarios.name: api-get
scenarios.exercises: +server.ts GET, json() helper, repeated query keys, locals set by hooks.server.ts

scenarios.name: api-get-error
scenarios.exercises: error(418) from an endpoint, JSON error body

scenarios.name: api-post-json
scenarios.exercises: request.json() body read, JSON round trip

scenarios.name: api-method-not-allowed
scenarios.exercises: 405 from the router when the endpoint has no DELETE

scenarios.name: redirect
scenarios.exercises: redirect(302) thrown from a page load

scenarios.name: action-form
scenarios.exercises: form action, x-www-form-urlencoded body, formData(), Set-Cookie, page re-render with form data

scenarios.name: action-fail
scenarios.exercises: fail(400) from an action, re-render with the failure payload

scenarios.name: action-devalue
scenarios.exercises: enhanced form submit: action result serialized with devalue instead of an HTML re-render

scenarios.name: urlencoded-plus
scenarios.exercises: '+' as space, in a query string and in a form body: the WHATWG urlencoded parser must decode it, and runtime-v8 currently does not

scenarios.name: csrf-blocked
scenarios.exercises: SvelteKit CSRF check: form POST with no Origin header is refused
